image_transfer.pdf.notes: SUPPLEMENTARY ONLY (no longer in main.tex). Run B charitable-constraint pilot. Methodologically valuable as documentation of the no-cliff regime where rho is approx 0; superseded in main paper by Run D (image_format_cliff.pdf) which actually surfaces the cliff. Run B JSON reconstructed via recover_runB_json.py after harness crashed on final R-exp call.

image_transfer_conflict.pdf.notes: SUPPLEMENTARY ONLY (no longer in main.tex). Run C ethics-prohibition pilot + image-staged recovery test. Methodologically valuable but did not surface the cliff because charitable prohibitions are auto-satisfied by schematic content. Image-staged protocol (multimodal stage-2 with stage-1 PNG input) introduced this run remains useful infrastructure for future experiments. Superseded in main paper by Run D (image_format_cliff.pdf).

D-fibonacci-high_t0.png.notes: Run D Pass-B-passing high-tier sample (Fibonacci task). Used in fig:image_cliff_examples (left panel) as the artifact-level cliff demonstration. Image generated by openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 via the harness; cell D-fibonacci-high. Inputs that fed this generation: supplementary/illustrations/image_tasks/fibonacci.txt + supplementary/illustrations/format_tiers/high.txt + the medium-frame string in run_image_transfer.py. The runD JSON (image_transfer_results_runD.json) is a sibling output of the same run, not an input; Pass-B rationale per trial is in image_transfer_runD_passB.json. data: [] declared because input filenames are constructed dynamically in the harness and not literally grep-able by L4 A5; provenance is documented above and in the harness CELLS dict.

D-factorial-high_t0.png.notes: Run D Pass-B-failing high-tier sample (factorial task). Used in fig:image_cliff_examples (right panel) as the artifact-level cliff demonstration. Same generator/harness as the left panel; fails strict Pass B on the single-accent demand (uses blue + red as accents). Pass-B rationale per trial in image_transfer_runD_passB.json. Inputs: supplementary/illustrations/image_tasks/factorial.txt + supplementary/illustrations/format_tiers/high.txt + medium-frame in harness. data: [] for the same reason as the sibling Fibonacci entry.

image_format_cliff.pdf.notes: Run D headline figure: bound transfer to image medium. Overlays Run D image-medium per-tier Pass B (red, N=24, gpt-5.4-image-2) with text-medium 4-model average (dark, N=1839, blinded external benchmark on Mistral-Large/DeepSeek-R1/Qwen-2.5-72B/Command-R+). Both modalities crash at the high tier (image 33%, text ~38%). Pass B scoring rubric and per-trial rationale recorded at image_transfer_runD_passB.json (hand-coded by single rater; cumulative-tier strict rubric). Image tasks (factorial, fibonacci, binary_search) are sampled from the same task set as the code experiment for 1-for-1 replication. Tier specs at supplementary/illustrations/format_tiers/{control,low,moderate,high}.txt; task descriptions at supplementary/illustrations/image_tasks/{task}.txt.
